mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions are 63 degrees under overcast skies with a waning crescent moon visible over Badger Ridge Middle School.

The Verona Police Department recently announced the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson regarding an incident from 2019, and the city is continuing road construction on Highway M with traffic patterns shifting starting the week of September 7.

Today you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness, and tomorrow features a variety of trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the farmer's market arriving on September 9.
Regarding the police weekly report, on Sunday, August 30, the school district notified officials of an incident, leading to the arrest of a staff member for sexual assault of a child.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach and the store opens today at 10:00 AM so be sure to plan your visit accordingly.
